purpose: Provider boundary for the Central Aldernia Clock governed runtime worker. Time may wake already-authorised duties but does not create authority.
forbidden: provider/account permission changes by the worker
failure_mode: If the dedicated Google WIF/Drive identity is unavailable, leave all ordinary duties unclaimed and report PROVIDER_ACCESS_NOT_CONFIGURED. If Google/Drive is available but OpenAI WIF/fallback is absent, unsupported non-Heartbeat duties may still fail closed after current-source retrieval without model execution, while supported model-bearing duties remain PENDING_RUNTIME and runtime-health reports PROVIDER_ACCESS_NOT_CONFIGURED. Do not simulate autonomy or widen the dedicated patrol identity into general Government/House execution.
openai_auth_preference: GitHub Actions OIDC -> OpenAI workload identity federation -> short-lived OpenAI access token
bounded API key fallback only where WIF is not yet configured
unsupported_duty_behavior: With current Google/Drive access, retrieve required current sources and terminally ACK STOP without any OpenAI provider or model execution. No generic professional handler is inferred.

shared_model_budget.scope: Combined GPT-5.6 Luna calls from the ordinary-duty runtime and integrity patrol.
shared_model_budget.stop_rule: Before every supported ordinary-duty model call, guard projected input plus maximum output. If projected local monthly estimated spend would exceed USD 4.00, leave the event unclaimed and persist runtime-health as BUDGET_STOP. Patrol uses the same ledger and cap.
